verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party Sync add-on documents version history that lets you 'view or restore previous versions of a note', and the Sync product page also lists the feature. That covers the core view-and-restore part of the story, though only through one-line mentions. missing for 10: evidence for recovering deleted notes, detail on retention depth and how the history UI works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
